headline: CPP and Ontario Teachers Acquire Co-Ownership in Cary Group
summary: Canadian pension funds CPP Investments and Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan entered as co-owners of vehicle glass repair firm Cary Group alongside Nordic Capital, as private equity investor CVC sold its stake.
why: Cary Group is a European market leader in vehicle glass repair and calibration services, historically operating as a roll-up across the Nordic and European markets.

impacts.name: Cary Group
impacts.why: Long-term institutional backing from major Canadian pension funds prepares the firm for future public listing.
